units.source_text: 从龙村回来的当天夜里，千重子做了一个梦—

en.t: That night, after returning from Tatsumura, Chieko had a dream—

units.source_text: 成群色彩斑驳的鲤鱼，向蹲在池边的千重子脚下聚拢过来，

en.t: schools of brightly mottled carp gathered around Chieko's feet as she crouched beside the pond,

units.source_text: 相互挤成一堆，有的纵身跳跃，也有的把头探出水面。

en.t: crowding together in a heap, some leaping up, others poking their heads above the water.
